scope.pathGrammar: active WorkObject folders live directly under $PROJECTS_ROOT/thoughtseed/<folder>
scope.vaultBoundary: thoughtseed-labs is R2/vault infrastructure context, never a WorkObject folder

whenRenamesHappen.phase: after the source-controlled mapping queue is settled and the founder approves an exact relocation manifest
requiredBeforeLiveApply: founder-approved manifest with exact from/to paths
archive or rollback target for every changed folder
root-map digest regeneration after accepted physical state

decisions.subject: thoughtseed-labs
decisions.decision: keep as R2/vault infrastructure context, not an active project folder and not a WorkObject folder

decisions.subject: cambium / cambium-authoritative
decisions.decision: archive the stale non-Git cambium folder first, then promote cambium-authoritative into the canonical Cambium shallow slot; do not create a second Cambium WorkObject
decisions.possibleLiveApply: archive or rename the stale non-Git cambium folder, then promote/swap the exact checkout into the canonical cambium shallow slot
blockedBy: founder approved ignoring _home-cleanup-2026-08-08 as nonblocking drift
live apply must be separately approved

decisions.subject: website / temperance-engine-landing-page
decisions.decision: website is a container; the nested exact repository maps to program:temperance-hermes and can only be promoted after local-only artifacts and ignore-policy drift are reconciled
decisions.possibleLiveApply: promote the nested exact checkout into the existing shallow temperance-engine-landing-page row, or keep the current container with an explicit exception
blockedBy: local-only artifacts must be inventoried and preserved
nested Git checkout must be clean or its untracked state must be archived
founder must approve whether to promote, de-duplicate, or preserve the container

decisions.subject: symphonics
decisions.decision: do not create a project folder or active mapping receipt for the planning repository until the future custom native SDK / Tuya React Native app disposition is exact
decisions.possibleLiveApply: create or map a shallow symphonics folder only after founder-approved manifest identifies the app/repository role
blockedBy: current repository evidence is planning/docs rather than implementation
future native app scope is intentionally ambiguous

decisions.subject: safvr
decisions.decision: keep mapped to branch:safvr-landing-page but out of active workflow
decisions.futureFilesystemAction: none unless the client relationship reopens

decisions.subject: virtualtryon-3d
decisions.decision: keep as root-map empty-hold evidence only; do not create sapling:virtualtryon or active mapping receipts
decisions.futureFilesystemAction: none unless a future founder-gated reopen reverses the retirement

decisions.subject: plugins
decisions.decision: do not rename; either attach a Git repository or fold into existing operator utility / engineering orchestration infrastructure
decisions.futureFilesystemAction: none until Git identity or fold decision is approved
